preset.name: Startup & SF culture
preset.tagline: Founders, VC, YC, and what the SF scene is on about
preset.description: The startup conversation: big raises and ARR milestones, founder and VC takes, YC and the SF scene, and the culture debates everyone's quote-tweeting.

focus.audience: people who follow startups, venture capital, and the San Francisco tech scene
care_about: The biggest startup conversations this week: what founders and investors on Twitter are talking about
Big startup moments: major raises and valuations, revenue and ARR milestones, acquisitions, notable hires and departures
Founder stories and advice with specifics: how companies were built, sold, or saved
Venture capital: notable funds, deals, investor takes, and debates about how VC works
Y Combinator, accelerators, demo days, and new programs and schools for founders
SF and Bay Area tech culture: events, parties, hackathons, and debates about work, hiring, and how startups should run
skip: Macro, public markets, stock moves, and infrastructure finance
Crypto token shilling and generic motivational threads
